notes.title: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance: Full Breakdown of Joe Musashi's Skills and Abilities
notes.content: [h3]Take Vengeance With The Full Power Of The SHINOBI[/h3][p]On June 2, Sega revealed the combat trailer for SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance – the revival of the classic ninja action series developed in partnership with Lizardcube. The combat trailer only offered a glimpse of the extensive arsenal of abilities available to players, so now we’re going to dive deeper into all the ways that Joe Musashi can traverse SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance’s extensive stages while taking revenge on his enemies.[/p][p][/p][h2]Combat Trailer[/h2][previewyoutube="ahKG2_5QRLw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Ningi Abilities Let Joe Explore SHINOBI’s Expansive Stages[/h2][p]Each stage in SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance features free-flowing exploration that utilizes a variety of abilities called Ningi. They range from a hang glider to the ability to simply punch through barriers… and enemies. As you unlock more abilities, you’ll be able to reach new areas containing valuable treasures and powerful foes. They’re also useful for navigating the challenging traps littered throughout each stage, from hydraulic presses to buzzsaws.[/p][p][/p][h3]Dash[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/dee84cf989d4409536ba481600d1a2124a065f3c.gif"][/img][/p][p]The first ability you get in SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance is one of the most useful - Dash! It not only allows Joe Musashi to traverse gaps and close quickly on enemies, it’s one of the keys to chaining together combos and slashing through enemies. A ninja essential![/p][p][/p][h3]Cannon Punch[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/1db5802202735f8f53c3be6b3a6b83aa07f2583a.gif"][/img][/p][p]Some enemies have extra armor or shields, so this charge ability allows Joe Musashi to punch right through them. It can also be used to break down barriers and enter new areas![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ninja Claws[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/abae792f14bf4b0651d9e3ff5f8e1277bf832a03.gif"][/img][/p][p]Like all ninjas, Joe Musashi has tremendous upper body strength. These claws allow him to cling to certain walls and ceilings to explore new parts of each stage.[/p][p][/p][h3]Sword Dive[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/12b31d49efaa569fec01019be441c9fc355a3a73.gif"][/img][/p][p]When in the air, Joe Musashi can cleave through enemies with a powerful downward thrust of his katana. This attack not only launches enemies and charges up Execution Gauges, it can destroy Yokai Barrier floors. It’s also just really satisfying to use.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ninja Hook[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/c4816ff072e0bdedf839544d9ae17f653e4d5e58.gif"][/img][/p][p]What ninja doesn’t have a grappling hook? This handy ability lets Joe Musashi propel himself to hook anchors to get across gaps and access new areas.[/p][p][/p][h3]Glider[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/52f0045971895b3b05ef615432a3b1eb62f6720c.gif"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we have the Glider, which lets Joe Musashi navigate tricky hazards and divekick any unlucky foes who might be waiting. If he needs to go up instead of down, the Glider can also catch a strong updraft![/p][p][/p][h2]Ninpo: Elemental Arts of the Shinobi[/h2][p][/p][p]While Ningi abilities help Joe Musashi navigate the world of SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance, Ninpo is where his true power shines. These mystical ninja arts channel elemental energy and deadly weapon techniques to devastate enemies, break through defenses, and dramatically shift the momentum of battle. Each Ninpo ability offers a unique tactical advantage—some are best used up close, others from midair, and many are perfect for charging Execution Gauges to deliver finishing blows. Whether you’re carving through enemies with a Wind Slash or targeting a single heavily-armored foe with a Shuriken, mastering Joe’s full suite of Ninpo is essential to surviving the game’s toughest encounters.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fire Ninpo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/24889a8a7a5624446e88c914615e06183b6eb9be.gif"][/img][/p][p]One of Joe Musashi’s earliest Ninpo techniques lets him unleash a cone of fiery breath, scorching anything in his path. It’s a powerful finisher that deals heavy damage — perfect for ending fights in a blaze.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kunai Burst Ninpo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/a7933a6df7359945b01d8fccbf50e38031c18a05.gif"][/img][/p][p]Leaping into the air, Joe Musashi flips forward and hurls eight kunai in a wide fan beneath him, raining down on enemies in front and below. It’s a flashy aerial assault that fills enemy Execution Gauges fast — but with limited kunai, make each burst count.[/p][p][/p][h3]Water Ninpo[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/718e06030741916d05890ffdbc841190e2e69605.gif"][/img][/p][p]Focus, deflect, strike. This counter-style technique slices through incoming attacks and punishes armored enemies in a single graceful motion.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thunder Ninpo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/4088e3ba8721b77ecd7b211ea3423940981497f7.gif"][/img][/p][p]Become lightning. Zip through enemies in a blink, dealing damage as you pass. Ideal for charging enemy Execution Gauges while keeping your flow uninterrupted.[/p][p][/p][h3]Wind Slash Ninpo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/e2a2947ad38ecf5e45214c23c3223e054b186da8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Leap into the air and carve through enemies with a sweeping slash that sends a shockwave flying forward. A versatile move with both close-up bite and long-range sting that pierces through enemies.[/p][p][/p][h3]Shuriken Ninpo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/ebb09011c4386feb31db358a2d1f02e2796b1dfb.gif"][/img][/p][p]Throw a massive shuriken that carves into enemies and returns to your hand. Its heavy damage and armor-breaking power makes it a deadly boomerang in the right hands.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bomb Ninpo[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/f64aeee61e264ef6dbcdd0e8d9f1957768590ff5.gif"][/img][/h3][p]Toss an explosive surprise that detonates beneath your enemies, launching them skyward. A powerful opener—or finisher—against clustered foes.[/p][p][/p][h3]Great Serpent Ninpo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/4a68c39e72333f227d781685906e74359d5e6d06.gif"][/img][/p][p]Summon a colossal serpent from the depths of your energy reserves. It takes time to cast, but the destructive payoff is more than worth it.[/p][p][/p][h1]Ninjutsu: Unleash the Ultimate Technique[/h1][p]Once Joe Musashi’s Rage Gauge is full, he can channel his most devastating powers — Ninjutsu. These limit break-style attacks are rare, powerful, and come with stylish showcase animations that highlight just how deadly a master shinobi can be. Whether you're clearing the screen or clinging to life, timing your Ninjutsu can turn the tide of battle in a flash.[/p][p][/p][h3]Karyu[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/7205481877dd7c20b36966a6b35a9c38c6262e84.gif"][/img][/p][p]Joe calls upon the power of the dragon to engulf the battlefield in flames, incinerating every enemy onscreen or smashing a boss with heavy damage. It’s pure fire and fury — perfect for wiping the slate clean.[/p][p][/p][p]There are more Ninjutsu abilities to unlock, so stay tuned![/p][p]Take Vengeance with the Full Power of the SHINOBI[/p][p]From nimble traversal with Ningi abilities to the raw power of Ninpo and the spectacle of Ninjutsu, SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance gives you the tools to become the ultimate ninja. Each ability is designed not just to look cool, but to reward skill, timing, and creativity. Whether you're slicing through enemies with precision or calling down a dragon to turn the tide, Joe Musashi’s arsenal is as deep as it is deadly. So sharpen your blade, steady your spirit, and prepare to unleash your revenge in SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance when it releases on August 29, 2025.[/p]

notes.title: Get A First Look At The Prologue, Main Characters, And Stages!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/b482597f8503201991c0fbffab593fecf70a9b5e.jpg[/img]
A paramilitary faction known as ENE Corp seizes territories across the world, decimating their defenses in little time. Only one threat to their dominion remains: the Oboro Clan, led by the legendary Joe Musashi. Aware of the danger they pose to his ambitions, Ruse, the mastermind behind ENE Corp, launches a full-scale assault on Oboro Village. Musashi and his allies must fight back and put an end to ENE Corp's reign of terror.

[h2]Characters[/h2]

[h2]Joe Musashi[/h2]
The protagonist. Head of the Oboro Clan, a tribe of ninjas that has protected peace from within the shadows for generations. Though he's a man of few words, his clan puts their utmost trust in him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/902fd9f713be225eb9c409ca48149d19c3001c38.png[/img]

[h2]Lord Ruse[/h2]
The mastermind behind paramilitary organization ENE Corp. He commands his troops with callous tact and an iron fist. Fearing the might of the Oboro Clan, he sets in motion a plan to eliminate them once and for all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/14c7b81886727cdfbf0e5d34be872b5d721bd3ba.png[/img]


[h3]Yamato[/h3]
Joe Musashi's canine companion. Yamato can grow larger to aid Joe in battle or carry him on his back.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/37137a8ff021563efe60eb81d4a01847873b0f7d.png[/img]

[h3]Tomoe[/h3]
A spirited young member of the Oboro Clan who is fully devoted to Joe Musashi's tutelage. She dreams of becoming a ninja strong enough to shield the clan from any danger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/81fa4987e5e2e991939e4ba89fde827825907986.png[/img]


[h3]Naoko[/h3]
Joe Musashi's wife. Kind and mild-mannered as she is, she isn't afraid to offer Joe valuable advice and support from time to time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/1477ff925f7760cfe5ae31ce35a6be359b678d65.png[/img]

[h2]Oboro Village Stage Introduction Video[/h2]

notes.title: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance launches August 29th!
notes.content:
The iconic SHINOBI returns in this all-new 2D action platformer with a unique hand-drawn look created by the team behind the hit brawler Streets of Rage 4. 

Play as the legendary Shinobi Joe Musashi, master of the ninja arts and wielder of the Oborozuki, the great katana. After finding your village burned to the ground and your clan turned into stone, you must set off on a quest for vengeance, ready to face an unparalleled evil and avenge your clan.

In SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance, you will travel across uniquely handcrafted environments from secret military bases to rural Japanese villages, utilizing an arsenal of ninja skills, mystical attacks and deadly combinations and moves, such as the fatal Shinobi Execution, to take on any foes who would dare stand in your way. 

[previewyoutube=Ge__8Dan6bU;full][/previewyoutube]

SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance will be available August, 29, 2025!

Pre-order SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance and receive a 10% discount, the Original Arcade Outfit, and Fortune Hunter Amulet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/3820e56ba26e01f16acfd4473ea566bc4ef9161c.jpg[/img]

Purchase the SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition and play the game 3 days early, receive the Ghost Outfit, Medic Lite Amulet, In-Game Currency, Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, and SEGA Villains Stage, featuring bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.

It includes:  
• Base Game

o Starter Pack: the Ghost Outfit, the Medic Lite Amulet, and In-Game Currency
